items.title: OpenMage magento-lts Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability where the TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor fails to filter scripts in specially crafted HTML tags, allowing attackers to execute scripts in users' browsers.

items.title: OpenMage magento-lts Block Whitelist Bypass via {{layout}} Directive
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 has an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the template filter's {{layout}} directive, allowing administrators with content editing rights to disclose limited information.

items.title: OpenMage magento-lts Reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in error pages
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in its error pages, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute script in victims' browsers via crafted links.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Emergency Hotfix for Adobe Commerce Zero-Day (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix addresses CVE-2026-75650 (StyleSmuggler), a critical (CVSS 10.0) unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that was actively exploited as a zero-day.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges and take over customer accounts.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (PolyShell RCE)
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) that can lead to arbitrary code execution and has been actively exploited.
